title: ApexForgeAnalyticsEvent
description: Privacy-safe, aggregated telemetry event schema for Apex Forge Technology and Poe bot interactions.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the event.

page.description: Normalized URL path where the event occurred (e.g., /receipt-ocr/).

campaign.description: Attributed campaign identifier or organic source.

suggested_reply_count.description: Count of suggested follow-up prompts returned to user.

cross_product_handoff.description: Whether the event involved a handoff between tools (e.g., OCR to SQL).

owner_test.description: Flag indicating internal development or benchmark synthetic traffic.
